articles.summary: HONG KONG, July 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ATRenew Inc. (" ATRenew " or the "Company") (NYSE: RERE), a pioneer in technology-driven recycling and trade-in solutions for consumer products in China, today unveiled an upgraded overseas strategy at a dedicated launch event in Hong Kong.
articles.title: ATRenew Unveils Upgraded Overseas Strategy and Opens Its First ReRe Store in Hong Kong
